full_judgment: 14. To answered the first question, we have gone through the depositions of the witnesses and Exhibits filed by the parties. It appears that plaintiffs Exhibited Exhibit 1, certified copy CS khatian, produced the deed of acquiring title from Sarnalata dey by which Syed Ali Habib in certified copy as exhibt 7, plaintiffs also produced Exhibit 8 which is the deed of 30-9-1952. Plaintiff produced Exhibit 8 and 9 by which Syed Ali Habib at first got pattan, lease and thereafter, purchased the land from Sarnalata Dey in certified copy, Plaintiff also produced Exhibit 9 to 18 i.e. deed of purchase of the plaintiffs in certified copy, plaintiffs did not produce any original deed. We do not find any explanation as to whereabouts of the originals of these deeds as such, an averse presumption may be drawn against the plaintiffs.
